title: Unit 01 integrated communication mission and correction review

questions.prompt: Mission: you greet a new teacher at 9 a.m. Choose the opening.
questions.explanation: Bonjour and Madame provide a suitable polite daytime greeting.

questions.prompt: Mission: your name is Camille. Which sentence introduces you?
questions.explanation: Je m'appelle gives the speaker's own name.

questions.prompt: Mission: you need to spell « Inès ». Select the correct sequence.
questions.explanation: Inès has four letters, including an è with a grave accent.

questions.prompt: Mission: describe one female student as kind.
questions.explanation: Gentille agrees with feminine singular elle; est is singular.

questions.prompt: Mission: describe two red apples.
questions.explanation: Pommes is plural; rouges agrees with the plural noun.

questions.prompt: Mission: a friend needs your pen. Which classroom response is useful?
questions.explanation: Stylo is masculine singular, so mon is appropriate.

questions.prompt: Mission: you want the teacher to repeat the instruction. Choose politely.
choices: Pouvez-vous répéter la consigne, s'il vous plaît ?
questions.explanation: Pouvez-vous and s'il vous plaît suit polite classroom register.

questions.prompt: Mission: you are ordering water in a café. Choose the idiomatic phrase.
choices: Une verre du eau, s'il vous plaît.
Un eau de verre, s'il vous plaît.
Un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît.
questions.explanation: Un verre d'eau is a glass of water; de elides before eau.

questions.prompt: Mission: you say you have no milk. Which expression works?
choices: Je n'ai pas du lait, en général.
questions.explanation: Under simple negation, the partitive normally becomes de.

questions.prompt: Read the note: « Bonjour, je suis Nina. Je suis nouvelle dans la classe. » What is new?
choices: Nina is new to the class.
questions.explanation: Nouvelle dans la classe identifies Nina as newly joining the class.

questions.prompt: Read: « Tom a un frère et deux sœurs. » How many sisters are mentioned?
questions.explanation: Deux sœurs means two sisters.

questions.prompt: Read: « Les cahiers sont bleus, les trousses sont vertes. » What is green?
questions.explanation: Trousses are the feminine plural items described as vertes.

questions.prompt: Read: « Nous commençons le cours à dix heures. » When does class begin?
questions.explanation: Dix heures corresponds to ten o'clock.

questions.prompt: Read: « Le professeur écrit au tableau et les élèves écoutent. » Who is listening?
questions.explanation: Les élèves écoutent is the subject and action pair.

questions.prompt: Read: « Au café, le sandwich coûte six euros; le jus coûte trois euros. » What costs three?
questions.explanation: Le jus coûte trois euros explicitly identifies the drink's price.

questions.prompt: Read: « Je voudrais une salade sans fromage. » What ingredient is excluded?
questions.explanation: Sans fromage means without cheese.

questions.prompt: Read: « La boulangerie n'a plus de croissants. » What is unavailable?
questions.explanation: N'a plus de croissants indicates the bakery has run out of croissants.

questions.prompt: Read: « Après le déjeuner, nous retournons en classe. » What happens next?
questions.explanation: Après le déjeuner means after lunch, followed by returning to class.

questions.prompt: Integration: you meet a classmate and ask their name informally.
questions.explanation: Comment tu t'appelles is an informal question asking a person's name.

questions.prompt: Integration: your teacher asks how you are. Give a suitable response.
choices: Je vais bien, merci. Et vous ?
questions.explanation: Je vais bien answers the question, and Et vous returns it politely.

questions.prompt: Integration: you and a classmate study together. Which sentence works?
questions.explanation: Nous takes the -ons present-tense ending in étudions.

questions.prompt: Integration: you have two sisters. Which phrase fits?
questions.explanation: Avoir expresses having siblings; sœurs must be plural.

questions.prompt: Integration: you order two croissants. Which request is clear?
choices: Je voudrais deux croissants, s'il vous plaît.
questions.explanation: Je voudrais is polite, and deux counts the croissants.

questions.prompt: Integration: a café item contains a food that gives you an allergy. Which action is responsible?
choices: Assume every dessert has identical ingredients.
State the allergy and ask about ingredients before ordering.
Guess the ingredients from the name.
questions.explanation: Clear allergy communication and confirmation is safer than assuming.

questions.prompt: Integration: correct « Elles est très gentils ».
questions.explanation: Elles requires sont and feminine plural gentilles.

questions.prompt: Integration: the bill is eight euros, and you hand over ten. How much change is due?
questions.explanation: Ten euros minus an eight-euro bill leaves two euros.

questions.prompt: Integration: you did not hear a word's spelling. Which question clarifies it?
questions.explanation: Comment ça s'écrit asks how the word is written or spelled.
